acceptance_bindings.changed_bindings_require: Retain old failures/exploration; freeze the new bindings and rerun all affected variants. Never relabel old observations as execution under new bindings.

subcase_record_contract.nested_runs: P1-005 freezes all 16 inputs per order/profile; supported profiles complete every input, while excessive-lag variants may stop with the required explicit incomplete/timeout result. P1-019 obtains a new full 16-case report per edited/restored target. One parent variant passes only when its complete nested obligations pass.
subcase_record_contract.deliberate_failure_oracle: An expected refusal, 10/16 diagnostic report, timeout or quarantine passes the verification variant only when the specified failure behavior and absence of usable readiness are actually observed.
required_actual_fields: retained evidence paths and SHA-256 digests
subcase_record_contract.newly_discovered_edge_cases: Add regression variants without deleting failed history; refreeze and rerun affected acceptance coverage.
